landing.heroTitle: At the family reunion, never call anyone the wrong name again.

landing.tileTermsTitle: The right term for every relative.
landing.tileTermsBody: Tap anyone in the tree. From uncles and aunts to in-laws and second cousins, the term is worked out from the family tree.

deletable.title: Delete anytime

landing.closingTitle: While the elders can still be asked.

privacy.title: Privacy and family data
privacy.intro: A summary of how Sararia Family Tree handles your family's data.
privacy.filledTitle: Data is entered by family members
privacy.filledBody: Names, dates, photos, and notes in each tree are entered by that tree's members, not by Sararia. The tree's owner is responsible for who is invited.
privacy.privateBody: There are no public pages. Each tree can only be opened by members who have signed in with their account. Photos are stored without public access and are only served after membership is checked.
privacy.rightsTitle: Rights of people recorded (Indonesia's PDP Law No. 27/2022)
privacy.rightsBody: If you are recorded in a tree and want your data changed or deleted, contact that tree's owner. If that doesn't work, send a request to <email>hello@caanglabs.com</email> with the name of the tree; we will follow up.
privacy.deletionBody: The owner can permanently delete the tree together with all people, relationships, photos, invitations, and history from the Settings page.

invite.asEditor: as an {role}. You can add and edit family data.
invite.asViewer: as a {role}. You can view the family tree and profiles.
